description: Defines the 'base::File' class, a wrapper around OS-level file operations, including file opening, reading, writing, seeking, locking, and error handling. Contains enums for flags and errors, and a nested Info struct for file metadata.

classes.name: File
classes.description: A wrapper class for OS-level file operations, supporting open, read, write, seek, lock, unlock, and metadata retrieval.

methods.name: Initialize
methods.description: Creates or opens a file with specified path and flags.

methods.name: IsValid
methods.description: Checks if the file handle is valid.

methods.name: Seek
methods.description: Changes current position in the file based on offset and whence.

methods.name: Read
methods.description: Reads data from a specified offset into a buffer.

methods.name: Write
methods.description: Writes data to a specified offset from a buffer.

methods.name: GetLength
methods.description: Returns the current size of the file.

methods.name: SetLength
methods.description: Truncates or extends the file to a specified length.

methods.name: GetInfo
methods.description: Retrieves basic metadata about the file.

methods.name: Lock
methods.description: Attempts to take an exclusive lock on the file.

methods.name: Duplicate
methods.description: Creates a new reference to the same file handle.

methods.name: OSErrorToFileError
methods.description: Converts OS error codes to 'base::File::Error' values.

methods.name: GetLastFileError
methods.description: Returns the last global error as a 'base::File::Error'.

methods.name: ErrorToString
methods.description: Converts a 'base::File::Error' to a human-readable string.
